name: review_start
description: Start an asynchronous, read-only review of already-indexed Splunk telemetry. Concerns are candidates; the analyst decides.

name: review_status
description: Read persisted status and progress for a review run.

name: review_result
description: Read a completed review result, or status while the run is unfinished.

name: review_cancel
description: Request cancellation at the review's next checkpoint.

name: review_verdict
description: Record an analyst verdict for a concern and update the review queue.

name: review_queue
description: List concerns that still need an analyst decision.

name: review_explain
description: Return claims with verbatim reviewer-visible text for every cited event.

name: review_doctor
description: Check Splunk reachability and index counts, reasoning models, durable databases, and embedder-bound calibrations; optionally re-project anchors and recalibrate from the recorded benign slice.
